planned_math_to_code.statement: Take the polar decomposition F=R S with S=(F^T F)^(1/2).
For S=Q diag(s_j)Q^T, the Frobenius-nearest bounded S' is Q diag(clip(s_j,l,u))Q^T.
Set F'=R S' and re-integrate the resulting differential targets.
